name: Hue Target
description: Pulls two bands of colour towards targets: each band picks colours by hue, saturation, brightness and height in the picture, then moves their hue and saturation towards a target while keeping their luminance. Band A is aimed at a sky blue in the upper picture, band B at grass green anywhere.

params.label: Band A enabled
params.doc: Turns band A on or off.

params.label: Band A hue
params.doc: The centre hue of the colours band A picks up, in degrees round the colour wheel.

params.label: Band A width
params.doc: How wide a slice of the colour wheel band A picks up, in degrees; the edges fade out.

params.label: Band A minimum saturation
params.doc: How colourful a pixel has to be to count; greys and washed-out colours below it are left alone.

params.label: Band A minimum brightness
params.doc: How bright a pixel has to be to count; dark areas such as asphalt below it are left alone.

params.label: Band A position
params.doc: Where in the picture the band counts: top fades out towards the bottom (sky), bottom fades out towards the top, none counts the whole picture.

params.label: Band A target hue
params.doc: The hue the picked-up colours are pulled towards, in degrees, along the shortest way round the wheel.

params.label: Band A target saturation
params.doc: The saturation the picked-up colours are pulled towards.

params.label: Band A pull
params.doc: How far the picked-up colours move to the target: 0 leaves them untouched, 1 puts them exactly on the target; brightness is kept.

params.label: Band B enabled
params.doc: Turns band B on or off.

params.label: Band B hue
params.doc: The centre hue of the colours band B picks up, in degrees round the colour wheel.

params.label: Band B width
params.doc: How wide a slice of the colour wheel band B picks up, in degrees; the edges fade out.

params.label: Band B minimum saturation
params.doc: How colourful a pixel has to be to count; greys and washed-out colours below it are left alone.

params.label: Band B minimum brightness
params.doc: How bright a pixel has to be to count; dark areas such as asphalt below it are left alone.

params.label: Band B position
params.doc: Where in the picture the band counts: top fades out towards the bottom (sky), bottom fades out towards the top, none counts the whole picture.

params.label: Band B target hue
params.doc: The hue the picked-up colours are pulled towards, in degrees, along the shortest way round the wheel.

params.label: Band B target saturation
params.doc: The saturation the picked-up colours are pulled towards.

params.label: Band B pull
params.doc: How far the picked-up colours move to the target: 0 leaves them untouched, 1 puts them exactly on the target; brightness is kept.
